headlines.title: 49ers injury news ahead of the Cowboys game
headlines.summary: Trent Williams (shoulder) and Dre Greenlaw (knee) are both questionable for Sunday's game against Dallas after both were hurt at Thursday's practice. Williams did not practise on Friday, and Kyle Shanahan said a shoulder injury on a Thursday 'doesn't make you totally at ease'. If Williams can't play, Vederian Lowe steps in at left tackle, and if Greenlaw is out, rookie Jaden Dugger moves to weakside linebacker. Mike Evans (Achilles) is out for a third straight game and is the only Niner officially ruled out. Deebo Samuel (hamstring) has no designation after returning to practice, and George Pickens (hamstring) has no designation for the Cowboys.
headlines.whyItMatters: San Francisco is 7–1 and top of the NFC, so Williams's status matters most for the offensive line. Dallas is 4–5 and 2.0 games outside the NFC playoff line, so the game matters more to the Cowboys.

headlines.title: Kirk Cousins starts for the Vikings against the Packers
headlines.summary: Kevin O'Connell has named Kirk Cousins the starter for Sunday's game at Lambeau Field, after Minnesota traded for him. O'Connell called Cousins' ability to get reacquainted with the offence 'impressive'. The Vikings gave up a third-round pick for him, and the move came after a poor offensive showing on Monday Night Football. Cousins has 20 touchdown passes, second in the league behind Joe Burrow's 23. Five Vikings are already out, including tight end T.J. Hockenson and linebacker Blake Cashman.
headlines.whyItMatters: Minnesota (6–2) and Green Bay (6–3) are both in the NFC's top seven, so this game can shift seeding.

headlines.title: Lamar Jackson's thumb timeline
headlines.summary: Lamar Jackson is out after surgery on his right thumb. ESPN's Jamison Hensley projects a return as early as Week 16. Baltimore is 4–5 and 1.0 game behind the last AFC playoff spot. The Ravens play the Chargers on Monday night without him.
headlines.whyItMatters: If Jackson returns in Week 16, the Ravens will have played Weeks 10 through 15 without him, in the middle of the race for a playoff spot.

headlines.title: Chargers still winless at 0–8
headlines.summary: The Chargers are 0–8 after losing eight straight games, and their most recent loss came against the Texans. Ladd McConkey missed a second straight practice with back spasms, and Brenen Thompson has been unable to practise after missing six games. Tre' Harris moved from limited to full participation on Thursday. Cornerback Deane Leonard is back to full practice after a concussion.
headlines.whyItMatters: With McConkey and Thompson out, the Chargers' offence is missing its fastest receivers, and the season has not yet produced a win.

contextCard.title: How injury designations work
contextCard.body: Before each game, NFL teams list players as Out, Doubtful, Questionable or Probable. Out means the player won't play, while Doubtful means he is unlikely to play. Questionable means it's uncertain, and Probable means he is very likely to play. Practice reports (full, limited or did not practise) are the clues that usually come before the official designation.

nba.oneThing: Dejounte Murray has asked the Pelicans to trade him, and the team and his agent have started working on a resolution. Murray will not play while a trade is pending.

headlines.title: Dejounte Murray wants out of New Orleans
headlines.summary: Dejounte Murray has asked the Pelicans to trade him. The team said on Friday it will 'evaluate potential trade opportunities that are in the best interest of our organization'. His agent, Rich Paul, and team officials have started working on a resolution, and Murray will not play while a trade is pending. The request came after a 145–111 home loss to the Nets, the fourth straight defeat that leaves New Orleans 4–8. Murray had posted, then deleted, a message about what was going on inside the team. He was an All-Star in 2022.
headlines.whyItMatters: Murray is 30 and in his third season with New Orleans, which acquired him in a June 2024 trade from Atlanta. The Pelicans now have to decide whether a deal is possible while they are 4–8.

headlines.title: Reaves day-to-day, Dončić expected Sunday
headlines.summary: Austin Reaves has a bruised left heel and is listed day-to-day. The Lakers did not image the foot after X-rays came back clean. Reaves left Wednesday's 123–112 win over the Bucks midway through the third quarter after landing awkwardly. Coach JJ Redick expects Luka Dončić to play Sunday against Phoenix after he tweaked his right ankle. Collin Sexton and Quentin Grimes are also day-to-day.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Lakers are 11–2 and first in the West.

headlines.title: Kings open to trades as they speed up the rebuild
headlines.summary: The Kings are willing to discuss trades involving anyone on the roster except rookie Darius Acuff Jr., according to team sources who spoke to The Athletic. At 1–10, Sacramento is looking for ways to speed up the rebuild around Acuff. Acuff is averaging 26.2 points, 7.3 assists and 3.8 rebounds.
headlines.whyItMatters: Sacramento is 14th in the West, so the trade talk is about building around Acuff rather than chasing wins this season.

headlines.title: Kyrie Irving draws interest, but Dallas isn't moving him
headlines.summary: Rival teams would show serious trade interest in Kyrie Irving if the Mavericks made him available before the February deadline. Neither Irving nor Dallas has shown a desire to part ways. A trade before the deadline is not currently expected.
headlines.whyItMatters: Dallas is 7–5 and 10th in the West.

teamNews.title: Spurs win their 10th straight
teamNews.text: The Spurs beat the Bulls 124–119 for their 10th straight win, with Victor Wembanyama and Dylan Harper leading the way. Their three-guard lineup is part of the run, and San Antonio is 10–2, second in the West.

teamNews.title: Warriors visit without Steph Curry
teamNews.text: Golden State visits San Antonio without Steph Curry, who is out with a right oblique tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks. The Warriors are also missing Brandon Williams, Jimmy Butler, Moses Moody and Kristaps Porziņģis.

recaps.text: Devin Booker scored 30 points with seven assists and three steals as the Suns beat the Hornets 101–96 in a close game. Coby White had 21 points for Charlotte, and Naz Reid added 16 points and eight rebounds, but the Hornets couldn't close. Phoenix moves to 5–6 while Charlotte drops to 4–8.

recaps.text: The Timberwolves beat the Mavericks 133–94, with Bones Hyland scoring 24 points and LaMelo Ball adding 22 points and nine assists. Ball's six three-pointers were a big part of Minnesota's trend since the trade that brought him in, while Charlotte is 4–8 without him. Dallas, led by Zaccharie Risacher's 22 points, falls to 7–5 and Minnesota moves to 9–3.

recaps.keyLine: Barrett 31 pts, 14 reb, 5 ast · Quickley 26 pts, 4 reb, 6 ast · Maxey 27 pts, 2 reb, 8 ast · Embiid 20 pts, 4 reb, 3 ast
recaps.text: The 76ers beat the Raptors 123–112 behind 27 points and eight assists from Tyrese Maxey. RJ Barrett had 31 points and 14 rebounds for Toronto, and Immanuel Quickley added 26 points, but Philadelphia's depth carried the game. Philadelphia is 10–3, and Toronto is 5–7.

recaps.keyLine: Cunningham 52 pts, 5 reb, 11 ast · Jenkins 21 pts, 6 reb, 0 ast · Young 37 pts, 2 reb, 14 ast · Davis 30 pts, 15 reb, 4 ast
recaps.text: The Pistons beat the Wizards 144–140 in double overtime, with Cade Cunningham scoring 52 points and adding 11 assists. Trae Young had 37 points and 14 assists and Anthony Davis had 30 points and 15 rebounds for Washington, but Detroit won the close game. The Pistons move to 8–3 and the Wizards fall to 4–9.
